ROOT passive capture, finite stiffness and clocking contracts
13November2026Brisbane/12NovemberUTC18:08 review. Introduced scalar mechanics for an unpowered captured-load cartridge; no physical execution.

1. The extra operation after an active force balance

A prior bounded rollback construction opposed a loaded failed contact with a service tool, then proposed removing the contact-plus-counterholder as one internally stressed unit. Its .6J example used2000N,kjam5MN/m,kcounterholder10MN/m. It did not supply the manufactured transition from active force control to an unpowered positive lock.

ROOT now executed OWN ROOT_PASSIVE_CAPTURE_CLOCKING_AND_ENERGY_20261113.py. This is new independent standard-library code, not producer execution. All stiffnesses, errors and capacities below are introduced. The2mm lead and72tooth organization are an unqualified design starting point in the available P1 return, not a measured dog-engagement law.

Let host relative compliance c=1/kframe+1/kbar, prior endpoint separation r0, jam stiffness kj/rest separation rj, and passive counterholder stiffness kl/rest separation rl. Initial internal force is T0=kj*(r0-rj), opposed by the counterholder. A capture error eps changes its retained rest separation to
rl=r0+T0/kl+eps.
Host equilibrium gives
r=r0-c*R;
R=kj*(r-rj)+kl*(r-rl)
 =-kl*eps/[1+c*(kj+kl)].

Thus kl*eps is NOT generally the settled outer residual; host compliance feeds back into it. Conversely, a small outer residual does not bound the peak internal force during capture.

2. A concrete hidden-overload case

With c=7e-7m/N,T0=2600N,kj=.5MN/m,kl=36MN/m and one-sided capture-clock error2mm/72=27.7778um:
settled outer residual is-37.6648N;
settled jam force is2613.183N;
settled counterholder force is-2650.847N.

A linear undamped INSTANT-REST-OFFSET proxy starts at r0 and ranges to2*r_equilibrium-r0. Its peak counterholder force is3600N even though its settled outer reaction is below80N. The peak outer reaction in this proxy is75.3296N. A3kN counterholder cannot inherit qualification from either small outer value.

This is not an actual shaft-dog impact calculation. Rest offset cannot physically appear for free: capture must provide the corresponding preload/work and a real contact/engagement sequence. Screw/rotor inertia, tooth impacts, bearing play, friction, damping, latch springs, timing and actual force limits remain u
